# Fetch all transaction pages for May 2023 and collect all unique counterparty emails.
all_transactions = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=access_token, min_created_at=min_date, max_created_at=max_date, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_transactions.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total transactions fetched: {len(all_transactions)}")
print(f"Pages fetched: {page_index}")
